item.heading: 27-63 Permit required for awnings, shades, flags and banners.

records.html:
No person shall establish or maintain an awning, canopy, shade, flag, banner, or any appurtenance over a public street or sidewalk without a written permit issued by the city.

(Rev. Ords. 1962, § 4207; Ord. of 5-12-86; Ord. of 2-18-20(1))

records.html:
All projections over a public street or sidewalk shall be cantilevered or supported from above so as to leave the walk unobstructed. Columns or posts extending to the ground are prohibited.

(Rev. Ords. 1962, §§ 4207, 4208; Ord. of 2-18-20(1))
